data.reasoning: The package consists of standard AUR metadata (.SRCINFO), a typical PKGBUILD that downloads pre-built theme tarballs from the official upstream GitHub repository, and a helper script (gen.sh) used by the maintainer to generate the PKGBUILD. The deepseek model successfully reviewed gen.sh and confirmed it only queries the official GitHub API for release assets, posing no security risk. The qwen model's inconclusive verdict was solely due to an API error when processing gen.sh, not a security concern.
data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was caused by a tool error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError) in the qwen model when attempting to audit gen.sh, forcing an inconclusive verdict. The deepseek model successfully audited the same file and found it safe.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review gen.sh due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400).
learnings: The audit tool should handle LLM API errors for individual files more gracefully, perhaps by retrying or falling back to another model's successful review of the same file, rather than failing the entire audit if the file is not critical or has been covered elsewhere.
